title: 2002 HMMT February Guts Problem 19
statement: For how many integers \(a(1 \leq a \leq 200)\) is the number \(a^{a}\) a square?

solutions.text: 107 If \(a\) is even, we have \(a^{a}=\left(a^{a / 2}\right)^{2}\). If \(a\) is odd, \(a^{a}=\left(a^{(a-1) / 2}\right)^{2} \cdot a\), which is a square precisely when \(a\) is. Thus we have 100 even values of \(a\) and 7 odd square values \(\left(1^{2}, 3^{2}, \ldots, 13^{2}\right)\) for a total of 107 .
